title_en: Undergraduate Field Trip to Industry and Research Institutions, February 2027
summary: The Department of Nuclear Engineering will hold an official two-day (one night) undergraduate field trip on 22–23 February 2027, visiting one site in Suwon and four in Daejeon. Undergraduate students in the department are encouraged to take part; no action is required yet. The detailed schedule and application method will be announced in December.
applies_to: Undergraduate students of the Department of Nuclear Engineering. Participation is encouraged, not stated as mandatory.

dates.what: Undergraduate field trip (two days, one night)
Further announcement of the detailed schedule and how to apply
dates.when: December (year as stated in the notice: not specified)

steps: Wait for the follow-up notice in December, read it for the detailed schedule and application method, and apply as it instructs.
translation:
[Notice: Department of Nuclear Engineering Undergraduate Field Trip]

In accordance with the results of the student council vote, an undergraduate field trip will be held over two days (one night), as follows.

Schedule: 22–23 February 2027 (two days, one night)

Institutions to be visited:
(1) Samsung Electronics Innovation Museum (Suwon)
(2) KEPCO Nuclear Fuel (핵연료주식회사) (Daejeon)
(3) Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute (Daejeon)
(4) Korea Institute of Machinery and Materials, Semiconductor Plasma Technology Center (Daejeon)
(5) Korea Institute of Fusion Energy (Daejeon)

The department will make official field visits to institutions that can help undergraduate students of the Department of Nuclear Engineering explore a variety of career paths.

Alumni of the department who are working at each institution will guide the visits, which is expected to be of great help as you consider your careers. We encourage your interest and participation.

The detailed schedule, application method and other details will be announced again in December.
